events.title: Carolina Mountain Club Joint Work Day
events.description: Join Carolina Mountain Club and Pisgah Area SORBA for a joint work day on the north side of Pink Beds! No experience is necessary - the Carolina Mountain Club and Pisgah SORBA Trail Crew Leaders will provide all tools, guidance, and instruction. We’ll meet at the new paved parking lot next to the Ranger Station and carpool up to Pink Beds. Date: Friday, October 9th Time: 8:30 AM – 2:00 PM Trail Work Location: North side of Pink Beds Loop Meetup Location: Pisgah Ranger Station/Visitor Center Required items: Long pants, boots that cover your ankles, safety glasses, gloves, hardhat (bike helmets DO NOT count, but climbing helmets do), snacks/lunch and water.
